analysis.reasonEn: Recent 5-day -5.5% decline pushed RSI to 32.3, entering oversold territory. MACD histogram continues to worsen at -3.1012. ADX at 28.9 indicates a trend, but -DI is significantly higher than +DI, showing downside pressure dominance. Weekly RSI at 40.1 is in a weak zone. 4-hour RSI at 30.0 also entered oversold. Daily Bollinger Band approaches the lower band at $188.74. Volume is subdued at 0.81 of the 5-day average. While the overall market is in a hold zone, this stock maintains a downtrend and weak technical indicators, warranting a wait-and-see approach.
